dataset.name: UCI Thyroid Disease Benchmark Dataset (allhypo)
dataset.source: UCI Machine Learning Repository / Garavan Institute

tree_structure.rules_text:
|--- TSH <= 6.05
|   |--- class: negative
|--- TSH >  6.05
|   |--- FTI <= 64.50
|   |   |--- thyroid_surgery <= 0.50
|   |   |   |--- T3 <= 2.25
|   |   |   |   |--- class: primary hypothyroid
|   |   |   |--- T3 >  2.25
|   |   |   |   |--- class: primary hypothyroid
|   |   |--- thyroid_surgery >  0.50
|   |   |   |--- class: primary hypothyroid
|   |--- FTI >  64.50
|   |   |--- TT4 <= 59.00
|   |   |   |--- class: primary hypothyroid
|   |   |--- TT4 >  59.00
|   |   |   |--- age <= 6.00
|   |   |   |   |--- class: primary hypothyroid
|   |   |   |--- age >  6.00
|   |   |   |   |--- on_thyroxine <= 0.50
|   |   |   |   |   |--- thyroid_surgery <= 0.50
|   |   |   |   |   |   |--- class: compensated hypothyroid
|   |   |   |   |   |--- thyroid_surgery >  0.50
|   |   |   |   |   |   |--- class: negative
|   |   |   |   |--- on_thyroxine >  0.50
|   |   |   |   |   |--- sex_M <= 0.50
|   |   |   |   |   |   |--- class: negative
|   |   |   |   |   |--- sex_M >  0.50
|   |   |   |   |   |   |--- class: negative

limitations: Historical Garavan Institute dataset collected in 1987.
Model predictions serve solely as an experimental research tool.
High test accuracy on negative class reflects pronounced class imbalance typical of general screening cohorts.
